title: Pre-MSA Flock contract and deployment authorization (Nov 2022–Aug 2023)
summary:
Asked for any contract, MOU, or written authorization in effect between the first Flock invoice (Nov 12, 2022) and the August 2023 Master Services Agreement, plus any deployment-authorization records for that period.

Item 1 produced a 2020 Phase 1 Services Agreement: 12 cameras, $24K/year, signed by Lt. Mefford. Item 2 (deployment authorization) closed 2026-06-02 with a determination that no responsive records exist.

prior_pra_refs.note: W012159 produced the 2023 MSA and its first amendment. This request covers the 9-month window between the first invoice and MSA execution.

filed_because: Cameras were active before the 2023 MSA. The request asks what contractual or written authorization was in place during the prior period.
notes:
Item 1 production established the existence of a 2020 Phase 1 Order Form predating the MSA. This finding informed W012459-040226 (post-2020 Council follow-up) and W012460-040226 (Council authorization for 2020 deployment).

Item 2 promised date was extended through a rolling email search; on 2026-06-02 the City completed its response with a good-faith determination that no records responsive to Item 2 exist and closed the request.
